_comment: Functional graphemes for Swedish. The sj-sound spellings (sj, skj, stj, sch, ch), the tj-sound (tj, kj), ng (/ŋ/), ck (/k/), the /j/ spellings dj, gj, hj, lj, the retroflex clusters rs, rt, rd, rn, rl (one retroflex segment in WikiPron's broad transcription), and doubled consonants after a short vowel (one consonant phoneme). Known limits: k/g/sk before front vowels (kör, göra, skina) are single letters here and segment only when the count matches; see data-prep/docs/grapheme-phoneme-alignment.md.
